item.title: “Opportunity” for corporate manslaughter law before term ends, minister says
item.description: THERE may yet be an “opportunity” to introduce long-awaited corporate manslaughter legislation in Jersey before the end of the current term of office, the Home Affairs Minister has revealed. Deputy Mary Le Hegarat suggested there may be an way of creating a corporate manslaughter offence without necessarily introducing a standalone new law.
